title: Patch v0.2.12: More card patches
notes: Plastic Surgery can no longer be played with no Unit to target, though a cast with none still fizzles (R657). Craft a Card's Radiant face no longer draws a card. Crushing Walls now closes spiked walls in on lanes 1 and 5, and a card in your hand that Plague Chalice would counter now wears a green warning (R658).
